notes.1: One bowl serves 4 as a side with rice.

move.title: Eggs in the steam
move.body: Gyeran-jjim is Korean steamed eggs: soft, puffy, and silky, eaten with rice. Today you'll whisk eggs with broth, set the bowl in a steamer, and cook them gently with the lid on until they're set.

why.title: Gentle heat for eggs
why.body: Eggs get rubbery in a hot pan. Steam is gentler, so the eggs set soft and smooth.

why.title: Whisk well
why.body: Whisking mixes the yolk and white all the way. Then the eggs cook to one even color.

why.title: Plain salt
why.body: Many Korean cooks season gyeran-jjim with a salty seasoning made from sea creatures the food rules leave out. This recipe uses plain salt instead.

why.title: Set, not runny
why.body: The eggs are done when the middle jiggles a little but a knife comes out with no runny egg.

wrong.sign: The top is bubbly and full of holes
wrong.fix: The water boiled too hard. Turn the heat lower next time.
Put the lid back on and steam 2 more minutes.
Sprinkle a pinch of salt and a few drops of sesame oil on top.

quiz.q: Why steam eggs instead of frying them?
choices: Steam is gentle, so they stay soft

quiz.explain: It keeps the dish clean and simple.

quiz.q: How do you know the eggs are done?
choices: A knife comes out with no runny egg
quiz.explain: The middle can jiggle a little.

steps.text: Put the steamer basket in the pot. Pour in the pot's water below the basket.
steps.look: Water under the basket, not over it.

steps.text: Put the lid on. Bring the water to a boil over high heat.
Crack the eggs into the medium bowl.
steps.tip: Fish out any shell with a bigger piece of shell.

steps.text: Wash your hands with soap, and throw away the shells.
Add the broth and salt. Whisk until there are no streaks of white.
Pour the eggs into the heatproof bowl.
steps.look: The bowl is about three-quarters full.

steps.text: Slice the green onions thin. Stir half into the eggs.
steps.tip: Keep the rest for the top.

steps.text: With oven mitts, lift the lid, far side first. An adult sets the bowl in the basket.
steps.tip: Keep your face back from the steam.

steps.text: Put the lid on. Turn the heat to medium-low, so the water bubbles gently.
steps.look: Puffed up, and set at the edges.

steps.text: While the eggs steam, heat the rice pouches in the microwave as the package says.
steps.tip: Squeeze the pouch first to break up the rice.

steps.text: Lift the lid away from you. Push the butter knife into the middle. It should come out with no runny egg.

target.look: Set all the way; a knife comes out with no runny egg

steps.text: Turn off the stove. An adult lifts out the hot bowl with oven mitts.
Drip the sesame oil on top. Scatter the rest of the green onion and the sesame seeds. Serve with the rice.
steps.look: Puffy, golden, and shiny on top.
